notes: TIP-ON for doors from the Blum Catalogue and technical manual 2024/2025, printed pages 190-193. The short 956. suits overlay fronts up to about 1300 mm high, the long 956A taller overlay fronts and all inset fronts; both with unsprung hinges. Fitted on straight adapter plates (no drilling). BLUMOTION for doors (pp. 176-189) is an add-on damper; CLIP top BLUMOTION hinges have it built in, so the app adds none. Not verified by a person.
